stdout:
Create a playlist. Use this tool to create a playlist.

Usage:
  yutu playlist insert [flags]

Examples:
# Create a public playlist
yutu playlist insert --title 'My Playlist' --channelId UC_x5XG1OV2P6uZZ5FSM9Ttw --privacy public
# Create a private playlist with description
yutu playlist insert --title 'Tutorial Series' --channelId UC_x5X --privacy private --description 'My tutorials'
# Create an unlisted playlist with tags
yutu playlist insert --title 'Music' --channelId UC_x5X --privacy unlisted --tags 'music,pop'

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string     Channel id of the playlist
  -d, --description string   Description of the playlist
  -h, --help                 help for insert
  -l, --language string      Language of the playlist
  -o, --output string        json|yaml|silent
  -p, --privacy string       public|private|unlisted
  -a, --tags strings         Comma separated tags
  -t, --title string         Title of the playlist
      --yes                  Confirm the operation
